title: Menu rows and cross links in the mocks cannot be reached from the keyboard
goal: In the design study, a lot of things you click are not buttons underneath: menu rows, the cards that link one page to another, even words in a sentence that jump you somewhere. A mouse reaches all of them and the keyboard reaches none, so anyone driving by keyboard hits a dead end at every menu. Make the things that respond to a click respond to Tab and Enter too.
notes:
Found while giving icon buttons accessible names on 2026-08-24. shared/components/core.js binds click to ANY [data-target]; menus bind [data-menu] the same way. Measured across 12 representative pages: 63 of 151 [data-target]/[data-menu] elements are neither button/a nor carry role or tabindex, so they are absent from the accessibility tree entirely. The shell.js harvest path was already fixed in c57d129 (role=button + tabindex + Enter/Space for non-native harvested chips); the same treatment belongs in core.js for [data-target] (role=link) and wherever [data-menu] is bound, plus role=menuitem on .menuitem rows. Watch the tab-order cost: some [data-target] elements are big rows and cards, so consider whether a card and its inner controls should be one stop or several. check-a11y-names.mjs could grow a second rule to gate this.

Shipped 2026-09-01. core.js owns the keyboard sweep (upgradeLinks / upgradeSections / upgradeMenus, run at load + MutationObserver with a 200ms ceiling like tooltip.js) and publishes PZ.menu {enter, close, upgrade}; popover.js and dock.js call enter() on a keyboard open and close() on Escape; segmented.js marks its seg-menu data-keys=own. Focus rings: links.css [data-target][tabindex]:focus-visible, app-patterns.css .menuitem:focus-visible (hover fill + ring), inspector.css .sec-h:focus-visible. Measure with `node shared/audit-keyboard.mjs [pages] [--walk]` from docs/design/mocks (needs the dev server on :8791 and Playwright, resolved from npm root -g, plus /Applications/Google Chrome).
acceptance: Every menu row in the study takes keyboard focus and opens on Enter or Space
Every cross-page link card and inline jump word does the same
Tabbing through a page never passes a clickable thing without stopping on it
A screen reader announces each of them as a menu item or a link, not as plain text

adversarial review before building: (1) one Tab stop per MENU with arrow keys, not one per row, because a page holds up to 41 rows and a keyboard user should not pay 41 Tabs; (2) a card and the buttons inside it stay separate stops, with the key handler guarded to e.target so Enter on an inner button never also opens the card; (3) Enter only for role=link, Enter+Space for menu items and headers, matching native; (4) focus goes into a menu only on a keyboard open (:focus-visible on the trigger), like a native menu; (5) collapsible .sec-h headers were also mouse-only and live in core.js, so they got the same treatment; (6) no static gate is possible since the affordance is runtime, so the gate is the browser audit

found two real bugs on the way: dock.js .dgrp-h keydown handled Enter bubbling from ANY button inside the header (collapsed the group and swallowed the press, so menu triggers in panel headers never opened by key); shell.js appends the Home menu row after core.js has bound clicks, so Home had no click at all. Both fixed (guard e.target===h; core.js sweep re-runs on DOM change)

harness lessons: postMessage is a task so the nav check must wait rather than read immediately; walkthrough pages pre-open #mbMenu on step 1 so Enter correctly toggled it closed, the audit now closes popovers before each trigger test; a disabled slot trigger is not a failure
